fichas.title: Intensive care medicine
fichas.summary: Intensive care is intended for patients with significant disturbance of vital bodily functions. The text emphasizes short routes to surgery and anaesthesia, separation from general care through controlled lobbies, visibility from an open nurses’ station, and connections for oxygen, compressed air and vacuum at every bed. Bed layouts may be open, closed or combined.
furniture_equipment: Half-height partitions with glazed window elements

fichas.summary: The drawing shows two single bedrooms, each labelled 20 m², arranged around a working corridor and support point. The beds are visually separated, with clinical equipment arranged around each patient space.

fichas.title: Intensive care ward, Luckenwalde Hospital
fichas.summary: A plan of a 10-bed intensive care ward includes clean and unclean workrooms, disposal, and a bed vestibule for visitors and supplies. The accompanying text describes the need for clean and dirty work areas and support spaces in an intensive care unit.
spaces: Bed vestibule for visitors and supplies
